Package org.yuemi.libs.api.folia

Class FoliaSchedulers

java.lang.Object
org.yuemi.libs.api.folia.FoliaSchedulers
public final class FoliaSchedulers extends Object
Static accessor for the FoliaScheduler. The actual implementation is provided by module-folia.

This is the entry point consumers use to schedule work that must run on both Paper and Folia. On Paper the underlying schedulers are shimmed, so a single code path is correct on both platforms.
